title: Leo’s Cardboard Rocket
subtitle: One brown box, two paper-plate dials, and a quiet trip to the moon.

Sister Maya checked her cereal-box clipboard while Biscuit wagged his tail.

“Engines ready?” he whispered. “Shhh-roar… up we go!”

pages.title: A Quiet Landing for Bedtime
paragraphs: The moon was soft and silver, and the stars were getting sleepy.
Leo docked his cardboard rocket right beside his cozy bed. Goodnight, moon.
